title: Talent Management
subtitle: Dr. Mourad & Dr. Sidki are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🏥

Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki are two talented dentists. Their practices are growing, and they now need to hire staff.

But the Moroccan Labor Code is a real headache:
- Employment contracts, probation periods,
- Dismissal, severance pay, notice periods,
- Working hours, overtime,
- Paid leave, maternity, wages.

A bad hire, poor management, and it's the labor court knocking at their door.

Their employees, their reputation, their peace of mind rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki are two talented dentists. Their practices are growing, and they now need to hire staff. They discover the basics of the Labor Code: employment contracts, probation periods, working hours.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki deepen their knowledge of the Labor Code: fixed-term contracts, maternity leave, staff representatives, safety and hygiene. They must manage their team in compliance with the rules.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki face complex HR situations: hiring, probation periods, dismissals. They must master the rules to avoid disputes.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki manage conflicts with employees, disciplinary procedures, labor courts. They must defend their practice while respecting the Labor Code.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki become references in dental HR management. They train young dentists in management and team retention.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and commitment, Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of HR skills and excellence to the dental profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki have laid the foundations of the Labor Code. But the road is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Rights and obligations are mastered. Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki are ready to manage their team.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Contracts and probation periods are mastered. Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Conflict management is mastered. Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: HR strategy has become a key skill. Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Mourad and Dr. Sidki have accomplished their mission. HR management is a lever for performance and happiness.
